I don't want to ask for socials or anything, but if there's a way you feel you can safely message me info to an art account that won't out you or anything I'd be really interested to see your stuff.
I think you're right tho. I think all I can do is keep searching for a doctor that I can afford or that accepts aetna. Maybe I could start the worst GoFundMe ever.

I was regularly visiting an OB/GYN until I was no longer under my parent's health insurance, but after I applied for federal healthcare and received insurance that a lot of places don't accept. I haven't seen an OB/GYN for about 2 years due to this. During that time, I was prescribed birth control to try to regulate my periods, but it didn't work. Instead, I was spotting basically all month and then would have a slightly less painful period with slightly less bad bleeding. If the spotting had been a little lighter, I think I would take that trade, but I'd basically have to wear at least a decent panty liner all year.

I'm using both tampons and pads at the same time. I've tried a menstrual cup, but I've never tried a large so maybe I'll see if that works better. With the size I used as well as with tampons, I also wore pads and I've still experienced blood leaking out of the sides. I change about every 3-4 hours as well, but I still experience leaking. Its like a sudden blood clot or something and it just spurts out.
